a.lede: TikTok will pay Alabama at least $100 million in a settlement tied to allegations that the short-form video platform misled users about safety and was designed to addict children.
a.title: TikTok agrees to pay at least $100M in Alabama settlement

b.lede: TikTok has settled Alabama's social media addiction lawsuit before it was supposed to go to trial.
b.title: TikTok will pay Alabama $100 million to settle social media addiction lawsuit
